services.name: Tour Requests
services.desc: Museum tours for schools consist of a museum tour and a city hall tour, including the city council chambers and the Mayor's office, if the Mayor's schedule allows. School tours are best scheduled for Tuesdays and Thursdays. Wednesdays may be scheduled if necessary, but the "city hall" component of the tour may be eliminated due to conflicts with space. Wednesday tours cannot accommodate more than 2 classrooms. Large non-school groups may be divided up into 2 groups of no more than 20 participants each, due to our space restrictions within the exhibits.
